decisive_items: Magnetic resonance imaging of the right shoulder and left ankle demonstrated findings consistent with osteomyelitis involving the scapula and the distal tibia
response.rationale: MRI explicitly shows osteomyelitis at two sites, directly supporting R2. R1 is inconsistent with imaging (joint vs bone). R3 is speculative pending culture and histopathology, not confirmed.

rejected.why: Symptoms suggest joint involvement but MRI confirms bone infection, not septic arthritis.
MDR-TB is a consideration but not confirmed; diagnosis rests on imaging findings of osteomyelitis.
